name: Haus Mary
beschreibung: The Haus Mary, run by the Hechenberger family, is a welcoming bed and breakfast situated in a central, sunny part of Söll in the Wilder Kaiser region. The bright guest rooms and non-smoking holiday apartment feature modern amenities, en-suite bathrooms, cable TV, and private balconies overlooking the Hohe Salve and rugged peaks of the Wilder Kaiser. In the morning, a wholesome breakfast buffet is served in the inviting lounge. A landscaped garden with sunbathing lawn, pavilion, and barbecue facilities provides a peaceful retreat after outdoor excursions. The lower gondola station into the expansive SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser–Brixental is only minutes away, with the ski bus stopping right nearby. In summer, the Hexenwasser theme park and Ahornsee lake are top local attractions.
kurzbeschreibung: Cosy bed and breakfast in Söll at the Wilder Kaiser with sunny rooms, garden, and quick access to the SkiWelt.
